mapper.sql: h.id, h.title, h.city_id, h.district_id, h.community, h.total_price, h.unit_price, h.area, h.room_type, h.floor, h.direction, h.decoration, h.build_year, h.address, h.longitude, h.latitude, h.surrounding, h.source_url, h.crawl_time, h.created_at, h.updated_at, c.name as city_name, c.province as city_province, d.name as district_name
mapper.select: select from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id where h.source_url = #{sourceUrl} limit 1
select from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id where h.id = #{id} limit 1
select from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id order by h.created_at desc, h.id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id

select from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id
order by ${orderBy}, h.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select avg(unit_price) from houses_house where district_id = #{districtId}
select avg(h.unit_price) from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id where c.name = #{city}
select avg(unit_price) from houses_house
select avg(total_price) from houses_house
select count(*) from houses_house where (#{cityId} is null or city_id = #{cityId}) and (#{minPrice} is null or total_price >= #{minPrice}) and (#{maxPrice} is null or total_price < #{maxPrice})
select count(*) from houses_house where (#{cityId} is null or city_id = #{cityId}) and (#{minArea} is null or area >= #{minArea}) and (#{maxArea} is null or area < #{maxArea})

select h.city_id as id, c.name as name, count(*) as total_count, avg(h.total_price) as avg_total_price, avg(h.unit_price) as avg_unit_price, max(h.total_price) as max_total_price, min(h.total_price) as min_total_price from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id group by h.city_id, c.name order by count(*) desc, c.name

select h.district_id as id, d.name as name, count(*) as total_count, avg(h.total_price) as avg_total_price, avg(h.unit_price) as avg_unit_price from houses_house h join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id where h.city_id = #{cityId} group by h.district_id, d.name order by count(*) desc, d.name

select c.name as city, d.name as district, count(*) as total_count, avg(h.unit_price) as avg_unit_price from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id group by c.name, d.name order by count(*) desc limit #{limit}
select room_type as name, count(*) as total_count from houses_house where room_type <> '' group by room_type order by count(*) desc, room_type
select room_type as name, count(*) as total_count from houses_house where city_id = #{cityId} and room_type <> '' group by room_type order by count(*) desc, room_type
select decoration as name, count(*) as total_count from houses_house where decoration <> '' group by decoration order by count(*) desc, decoration
select decoration as name, count(*) as total_count from houses_house where city_id = #{cityId} and decoration <> '' group by decoration order by count(*) desc, decoration

select period, count(*) as total_count, avg(total_price) as avg_total_price from ( select concat(year(crawl_time), ' Q', quarter(crawl_time)) as period, year(crawl_time) as year_value, quarter(crawl_time) as quarter_value, total_price from houses_house where crawl_time is not null ) trend_source group by period, year_value, quarter_value order by year_value, quarter_value

select period, count(*) as total_count, avg(total_price) as avg_total_price from ( select concat(year(crawl_time), ' Q', quarter(crawl_time)) as period, year(crawl_time) as year_value, quarter(crawl_time) as quarter_value, total_price from houses_house where city_id = #{cityId} and crawl_time is not null ) trend_source group by period, year_value, quarter_value order by year_value, quarter_value

select city_name, period, count(*) as total_count, avg(total_price) as avg_total_price from ( select c.name as city_name, concat(year(h.crawl_time), ' Q', quarter(h.crawl_time)) as period, year(h.crawl_time) as year_value, quarter(h.crawl_time) as quarter_value, h.total_price from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join ( select city_id from houses_house group by city_id order by count(*) desc limit 5 ) top_city on top_city.city_id = h.city_id where h.crawl_time is not null ) trend_source group by city_name, period, year_value, quarter_value order by city_name, year_value, quarter_value

select from houses_house h join houses_city c on c.id = h.city_id join houses_district d on d.id = h.district_id where h.longitude is not null and h.latitude is not null order by h.crawl_time desc, h.id desc limit #{limit}
select distinct room_type from houses_house where room_type <> '' order by room_type
select distinct floor from houses_house where floor <> '' order by floor
select distinct direction from houses_house where direction <> '' order by direction
select distinct decoration from houses_house where decoration <> '' order by decoration
